note: City of Bagley park campground on Lake Lomond, a few blocks from downtown and a short drive from Itasca State Park; swim beach, boat ramp, fishing pier, disc golf. --Claude
summary: City page read: $35 RV / $20 tent per night confirmed; season May 1-Sept 30 (now manual); reservations by phone (park attendants 218-694-2871 in season, city clerk 218-694-2865 off season); 'over 40' RV + 'over 10' tent sites, 10 seasonal. Hookups, 45-ft limit and showers not stated (left as stored). Lakefront could not be earned: proposed lakeview. No phone stored: add 218-694-2871.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (lakefront -> lakeview): the only RV pads visible on imagery are the ~10 seasonal sites on a gravel strip southwest of the beach (~47.5262,-95.4030), and they sit behind a 20-40 m band of reeds and trees at the lake's edge; seasonal sites don't earn the value anyway. The 30+ nightly RV sites could not be picked out on the (autumn, empty) imagery anywhere in the park; the open lakeside ground is the swim beach, boat ramp lot and day-use lawn. No site numbers or site photos found on the city's page. Under the unsure rule this goes down to lakeview (the park is on the lake with open lawn to the beach).
Phone missing: add 218-694-2871 (park attendants, May 1-Sept 30, on the city page); off-season the city clerk is 218-694-2865.
Website: https://www.bagleymn.us/ -> https://www.bagleymn.us/park-campground (the campground's own page).
Long-stay check: 10 of 'over 40' RV sites are seasonal (about a quarter); nightly rate posted; city-run. Not read as mostly seasonal.
Hookups (electric 30, water), sites.max_rig_ft 45 and facilities.showers are derived from old note prose; the city page states none of them. Left as stored, unconfirmed.
Pin 47.52750,-95.40150 sits on the beach; since the RV sites could not be located, no move proposed.

Note cleaned: dropped '40+ RV sites with 30-amp electric and water (some electric-only) plus tent sites, allows rigs to ~45 ft', 'showers' and 'Season May 1-Sept 30' (fields hold them or the page doesn't state them).
